title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Recognised Fee for the Remaining Treatment of a Moved Case
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders (Cascade Ortho Rider family): the recognised remaining-treatment fee.**

## The calculation

1. **Starting point.** The recognised remaining-treatment fee starts from the allowed case fee on the establishment entry of the case.
2. **Share of treatment still to come.** This share is the planned treatment months on the establishment entry less the whole calendar months from the banding date to the transfer date, divided by the planned treatment months, and never below zero. A calendar month counts as whole only when the day of the month of the transfer date is on or after the day of the month of the banding date.
3. **The fee.** The recognised remaining-treatment fee is that allowed case fee times the share of treatment still to come, rounded half up to the cent.

The fee is assembled in one fixed order:

- every part taken off the allowed case fee, and every part kept whole, is first set aside from the allowed case fee;
- the rest is multiplied by the share of treatment still to come;
- every part kept whole is then added back;
- the sum is multiplied by every percentage that applies;
- the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

## Which case, and edge cases

- The case is the one whose establishment entry is the latest establishment entry under the rider. When two establishment entries carry the same date, the one entered first counts as the latest.
- The case's transfer entries and payments are those carrying its case number.
- A case with no establishment entry has a recognised remaining-treatment fee of zero.
- A case whose planned treatment months are zero has a share of treatment still to come of zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The inputs: an allowed case fee of 4,860.00 on the establishment entry, 26 planned treatment months, and a banding date on the 20th of a month.

| Transfer date | Whole calendar months since banding | Share still to come | Recognised remaining-treatment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12th of the ninth month after the banding month | 8 (the 12th is before the 20th) | 18 of 26 | 4,860.00 times 18, divided by 26, is 3,364.615, rounded to 3,364.62 |
| 20th of the ninth month after the banding month | 9 | 17 of 26 | 4,860.00 times 17, divided by 26, is 3,177.692, rounded to 3,177.69 |
| any date 26 or more whole months after banding | 26 or more | zero (never below zero) | 0.00 |
